wingman_header.role: Schema for AI-initiated fullscreen content requests sent from backend to WingMan UI.
wingman_header.notes: Used by the UI command dispatcher to validate fullscreen overlay requests.

title: WingMan Fullscreen Command
description: Schema for AI-initiated fullscreen content requests sent from backend to WingMan UI.

role.description: Indicates the message originates from the AI.

type.description: Identifies this message as a fullscreen request.

html.description: Raw HTML content to display in the fullscreen overlay.

title.description: Optional title or label for the fullscreen content.

mode.description: Describes the AI's intent for the fullscreen content.

timestamp.description: When the AI generated this request.

source.description: Optional identifier for the subsystem that generated the request.

tags.description: Optional tags for categorization or filtering.
